author: Sonia Landes, Alison Landes, Rebecca Landes

chunks.summary: Walk 1: Saint-Julien-le-Pauvre — starting at the Petit Pont, exploring the oldest Left Bank quarter around Notre-Dame.
Walk 2: La Huchette — medieval streets off Place Saint-Michel, including rue de la Huchette and Saint-Séverin.
Walk 3: Saint-Germain-des-Prés — the abbey church, rue Bonaparte, Les Deux Magots, Café de Flore, Lipp.
Walk 4: Place des Vosges — the Marais, the royal square, Hugo's house, Hôtel de Sully.
Walk 5: Rue des Francs-Bourgeois — Marais mansions, hôtels of Soubise, Carnavalet, Lamoignon, Albret.
Walk 6: Bastille to Eglise Saint-Gervais — place de la Bastille, rue Saint-Antoine, Saint-Paul, Hôtel de Ville.

chunks.section_title: Walk 7: Les Grandes Trois: Concorde, Madeleine, Vendôme
chunks.summary: Walk 7: Les Grandes Trois — Place de la Concorde, the Madeleine, Place Vendôme, rue Saint-Honoré.
